why: Issue #1056's required control: swapping two of the three Machado matrices must change a pinned result. Protan and deutan are the pair most easily confused, and both are plausible-looking, so only known values can tell them apart: #d64545 reads #918441 under deutan and #6d6544 under protan, and the paint shop's Red and Green collapse to 6.75 under deutan but stay 24.47 apart under protan. Measured with colour-distance.ts on 2026-10-10 (origin/main c200cf62 plus issue #1056).
